title: Fitting Fee Computation Clause — Marlowe & Finch Alterations Extra Fittings
content:
**Clause.** The extra fitting fee on a Marlowe & Finch Alterations ticket is the fee basis multiplied by the extra fitting fee rate percent and divided by one hundred, plus the event-proximity surcharge and the small-job surcharge, less the wedding-party credit and the cardmember fitting credit. It is rounded half up to the cent once at the end, and it is never below zero.

On this clause the fee basis is the class's extra fitting fee for every extra fitting, the extra fitting fee rate is 100 percent, and there is no surcharge and no credit; the extra fitting fee is therefore the class's extra fitting fee, rounded half up to the cent.

**Rounding.** Half up to the cent: a figure at or above the half-cent mark, or within 0.0001 of a cent below it, goes up to the next cent.

## The clause as a calculation sheet

| Line | Content |
|---|---|
| A | fee basis |
| B | A multiplied by the extra fitting fee rate percent, divided by one hundred |
| C | B plus the event-proximity surcharge plus the small-job surcharge |
| D | C less the wedding-party credit less the cardmember fitting credit |
| Fee | D rounded half up to the cent, and nil if it is below zero |

## Worked example (hypothetical figures)

In a class whose extra fitting fee is, for this example, 30.00 USD, a customer books an extra fitting: fee basis 30.00 USD; rate 100 percent gives 30.00 USD; no surcharge and no credit; the fee is 30.00 USD. A second extra fitting on the same ticket is again 30.00 USD.
